related.title: LLVM Vectorizer：資料相依與合法轉換
related.titleEn: LLVM vectorizer: dependencies and legal transformations
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付RAJA政策契約、部分和證據與非零初值回歸；46/36與四部分和吻合，輸入被消費一次且初值唯一；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver policy contracts, partial-sum evidence, and nonzero-initializer regression tests. Verify 46 and 36, with each input consumed once and only one initializer. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫a0→a1→…→a8依賴鏈，另畫獨立b輸入；不可用pragma宣告消除真相依；10/13正確，轉換後逐元素吻合且每項編譯假設有證據。
related.differenceEn: Draw the chain a [0] through a [8] and separate independent inputs. A pragma cannot remove a real dependency. Verify final values 10 and 13 and every intermediate element. Supply evidence for all compiler assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: sum結果為初值s0加每個輸入一次；若每工作者重複加入非零初值，結果會偏移；合成輸入1..8，初值s0=10；改s0=0，工作分四組；名義式 10+8*9/2 = 46 sum；變更式 8*9/2 = 36 sum。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
遞迴a[i]=a[i−1]+1有跨迭代相依，與a[i]=b[i]+1的獨立元素不同；合成a0=2，遞迴做到i8；另起a0=5，仍8次遞迴；名義式 2+8 = 10 a[8]；變更式 5+8 = 13 a[8]。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The result is one initial value plus each input exactly once. Repeating a nonzero initializer per worker changes the answer. Synthetic inputs 1 through 8 with initial value 10 versus 0, partitioned into four groups. Nominal 10+8*9/2 = 46 sum; changed 8*9/2 = 36 sum. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

The recurrence a[i] = a[i−1]+1 depends on the previous iteration, unlike independent assignments a[i] = b[i]+1. Synthetic initial a [0] = 2 through i = 8; compare initial value 5 with the same eight updates. Nominal 2+8 = 10 a[8]; changed 5+8 = 13 a[8]. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Libfabric 完成佇列：注入、遠端完成與積壓」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付完成語意矩陣、佇列時間序列與背壓驗收條件。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Libfabric completion queues: injection, remote completion and backlog with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver a completion-semantics matrix, queue trace and backpressure criteria.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

由每 10 ms 到達 1000、消費 800 建立表，線性外推到 4096。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Tabulate 1000 arrivals and 800 serviced per 10 ms, then extrapolate to 4096.
